subject: Solid Waste and Recyclables Regulation Updates
overview: The Board approved revisions to solid waste, recycling, and dumpster regulations to align with city ordinances and state environmental standards. The updates include new reporting requirements for waste haulers and pest management mandates for dumpster permits.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the June meeting minutes with minor corrections.

items.title: Solid Waste and Recyclables Regulations
items.summary: Approved amendments to Regulation 5 and Regulation 6 to incorporate recycling requirements and align waste definitions with Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection standards. The revisions include a mandate for haulers to report annual tonnage and certify compliance with state waste bans.

items.title: Dumpster Rodent Control Requirements
items.summary: Mandated the submission of Integrated Pest Management plans for permanent dumpster permit applications to assist with city rodent control efforts.

items.title: COVID-19 Test Distribution
items.summary: Announced that free COVID-19 tests remain available to the public at the Health Department office.
